title: Average-reward reinforcement learning in semi-Markov decision processes via relative value iteration
abstract: arXiv:2512.06218v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper applies the authors' recent results on asynchronous stochastic approximation (SA) in the Borkar-Meyn framework to reinforcement learning in average-reward semi-Markov decision processes (SMDPs). We establish the convergence of an asynchronous SA analogue of Schweitzer's classical relative value iteration algorithm, RVI Q-learning, for finite-space, weakly communicating SMDPs. In particular, we show that the algorithm converges almost surely to a compact, connected subset of solutions to the average-reward optimality equation, with convergence to a unique, sample path-dependent solution under additional stepsize and asynchrony conditions. Moreover, to make full use of the SA framework, we introduce new monotonicity conditions for estimating the optimal reward rate in RVI Q-learning. translated_title: 基于相对值迭代的半马尔可夫决策过程平均奖励强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文将作者近期在Borkar-Meyn框架下关于异步随机逼近（SA）的研究成果应用于平均奖励半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDPs）中的强化学习。我们针对有限状态空间、弱通信的SMDPs，建立了Schweitzer经典相对值迭代算法的异步SA类似形式——RVI Q-learning算法的收敛性。特别地，我们证明该算法几乎必然收敛到平均奖励最优性方程解集的一个紧致连通子集；在额外的步长和异步条件下，可进一步收敛到唯一的、依赖于样本路径的解。此外，为了充分发挥SA框架的作用，我们在RVI Q-learning中引入了用于估计最优奖励率的新单调性条件。这些条件大幅扩展了此前考虑的算法框架，并通过新颖的论证在稳定性（原文在此处截断）方面得到了处理。
tldr: 本文将Borkar-Meyn框架下的异步随机逼近理论应用于平均奖励半马尔可夫决策过程，证明了RVI Q-learning算法的几乎必然收敛性，并提出新的单调性条件大幅扩展了已有的算法框架。
en_tdlr: This paper applies asynchronous stochastic approximation in the Borkar-Meyn framework to average-reward reinforcement learning in semi-Markov decision processes, establishing the almost-sure convergence of RVI Q-learning and introducing new monotonicity conditions that substantially expand the existing algorithmic framework.
